sentences.text: Wpcrl/555/2025 on 5 June, 2025

Author: Pankaj Purohit Bench: Pankaj Purohit  Office Notes,
 reports, orders  or proceedings SL. No. Date or directions COURT'S OR JUDGE'S ORDERS  and Registrar's  order with  Signatures  WPCRL No.555 of 2025  Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Naveen Singh Bisht, learned counsel for the petitioners.
2.
Mr. S.C. Dumka, learned AGA along with Ms. Sweta Badola Dobhal, learned Brief Holder for the State.

3. By means of this writ petition, petitioners have impugned the FIR No.0347 of 2025 dated 17.05.2025, lodged under Sections 323, 376(2)(n) & 506 IPC, registered at P.S. Kotwali Haridwar,
District Haridwar.

4 In nutshell, the averment made in the first information report is that the petitioner no.1 has committed rape with the informant-respondent no.3 on the false promise of marriage and petitioner no.2 helped petitioner no.1 in that act.
5. It is contended by learned counsel for the petitioners that petitioner no.1 is 22 years of age, while the informant-respondent no.3 is 32 years of age; is a married woman and has one issue also.
He further contends that petitioner no.1 earlier enticed away by the informant when he was minor and the complaint was made by petitioner no.2 to the Police.

6. Learned counsel for the petitioners has drawn the attention of this Court on page 39 of the paper book, which is a document written by petitioner no.2 to Police, wherein it has been stated that informant-Varsha Gupta has enticed away the son of petitioner no.2 aged about 20+.
This application was moved by petitioner no.2 on 01.03.2023.

7. Learned counsel for the petitioners also submits that in such view of the matter, there is no reason to file such an FIR to say that by false pretext of marriage, petitioner no.1 has ravished the respondent no.3- informant.
8. Per contra, learned State Counsel supported the case put up in the first information report and WPCRL/555/2025 on 5 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/18331320/

1 submits that that lady is pregnant by two months and she has been maltreated by petitioner nos.1 &
2.
9.

Having considered the submissions made by learned counsel for the parties and having gone through the record of the case, this Court is of the view that petitioners are entitled to get some protection from this Court for the reason that the petitioner no.1 is a young boy of 22 years of age and the informant is more than 32 years of age and already married having an issue.

10. Issue notice to the respondent no.3, returnable within six weeks.
11.
Steps to be taken within three days.
Till the next date of listing, no coercive measures shall be taken against the petitioners, pursuant to the impugned FIR, provided they cooperate with the investigation.
14. Stay application (IA No.1/2025) stands disposed of accordingly.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.) 05.06.2025
